summary: Delivered the opt-in Rust-native type-aware TSRX lane without changing the default OXC path. A distinct type-semantic projection preserves control-flow scopes, explicit cross-file .tsrx imports, mixed TSX/TSRX project membership, authored config intent, diagnostic spans, and exact identity-safe fixes. One documented tsgolint protocol-v2 process handles an eligible batch entirely through in-memory source overrides; missing or mismatched oxlint-tsgolint 0.24.0 fails without downgrade. The retained 9-test type-aware matrix, 60-test product matrix, Rust suite, and both default/type-aware performance gates pass.

architecture.projection: tsrx_syntax::TypeProjection is distinct from the syntax-rule projection and is built in Rust from the shared compact overlay. It retains loop element types, lexical bindings, catch context, component callability, and authored byte mappings while emitting legal TSX.
architecture.project_batch: LintSession prepares the explicit mixed project once and calls one adapter batch. TSRX receives in-memory .tsrx.tsx virtual names; ordinary TS/TSX joins the type project without entering the TSRX scanner.
architecture.config_paths: Canonical ConfigStore rules and overrides resolve against each authored path before virtual script naming, preserving **/*.tsrx intent and explicit .tsrx imports.
architecture.public_boundary: The public TsGoLintState source-override seam proves single-source use. Production multi-file work uses the pinned documented headless protocol v2 because the public helper's Message conversion drops file_path; no private/generated module, fork, patch, vendor source, disk projection, or AST JSON transfer is used.
architecture.fix_safety: Labels require complete authored endpoint coverage. Fixes require one exact safe affine identity range and the edited TSRX must pass the existing scan/project/OXC validation reparse; suggestions and synthetic or cross-segment edits are rejected.
architecture.default_path: Without explicit --type-aware/--type-check, the original Linter::run branch remains active, creates no TypeProjection, performs one OXC parse per file, and starts zero type processes.
architecture.version_boundary: oxlint-tsrx pins oxlint-tsgolint 0.24.0 exactly. The adapter discovers the public platform-native executable, verifies package identity/version, and rejects missing, unverifiable, or mismatched binaries actionably.
